QX50 Space & Cargo
SPACE & CARGO
Sometimes, you need space for guests and other
times for cargo, and QX50 has the flexibility to
comfortably accommodate either at a moment’s
notice. Split-folding, sliding and reclining
second-row seats allow you to maximize space
where you need it, with a maximum cargo
volume of up to 65.1 cu. ft. with rear seats
folded.2,3 The sliding function allows for 5.6 in.
of adjustment, with up to 38.7 in. of maximum
rear leg room.4,5 When your hands are full and
you’re on the go, quickly kick your foot under the
rear bumper, and the available Motion-Activated
Liftgate opens for you.
